title: Split boundary on a cocycle with an arbitrary lift
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] and $S=(A^\bullet\xrightarrow{i}B^\bullet\xrightarrow{p}C^\bullet)$ a sequence of integer cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with $ip=0$ and a splitting $(r^k,s^k)$ in every degree. Write $d:C^\bullet\to A^\bullet[1]$ for its split boundary [lem-weil-pbc-degreewise-split-connecting-morphism]. For any object M, integer n, cocycles $c:M\to C^n$, $a:M\to A^{n+1}$, and lift $b:M\to B^n$ satisfying $bp^n=c$ and $b d_B^n=a i^{n+1}$ in diagrammatic composition, composition of the shifted map corresponding to c with d corresponds in the derived category to the cocycle a. Equivalently, after mapping to D(A), the shifted composition of the fromSingleMk(c) map of degree n with d of degree one equals the fromSingleMk(a) map of degree n+1.

source.place: Tags 0152 and 06XR; split boundary components as in homology.tex Tag 011J

proof.text: Put t=b r^n. The splitting identity and b p=c give b=t i+c s. Compose with d_B and r^{n+1}, use the chain-map equation of i and i^{n+1} r^{n+1}=1, and obtain c s d_B r = a-t d_A. This identity includes arbitrary lifts b.

Under the unsigned cocycle/shifted-map equivalence, composition with the split degree-one boundary has component c s d_B r. Expand rightShift and rightUnshift and the component of shiftFunctorAdd inverse; all degree-change isomorphisms cancel. Thus its cocycle differs from fromSingleMk(a) by the coboundary of -t.

The cohomology-class boundary criterion identifies the two maps in the homotopy category. Localization Q identifies homotopic maps and commutes with shifted composition, proving the equation. No resolution or augmentation is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem degreewiseSplit_cocycle_boundary
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ))
    (σ : ∀ k : ℤ,
      (S.map (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) k)).Splitting)
    (M : C) (n : ℤ) (c : M ⟶ S.X₃.X n)
    (hc : c ≫ S.X₃.d n (n + 1) = 0)
    (b : M ⟶ S.X₂.X n) (hb : b ≫ S.g.f n = c)
    (a : M ⟶ S.X₁.X (n + 1))
    (ha : a ≫ S.X₁.d (n + 1) (n + 1 + 1) = 0)
    (hba : b ≫ S.X₂.d n (n + 1) = a ≫ S.f.f (n + 1)) :
    (ShiftedHom.map (Cocycle.equivHomShift.symm
      (Cocycle.fromSingleMk c (zero_add n) (n + 1) rfl hc)) DerivedCategory.Q).comp
        (ShiftedHom.map (homOfDegreewiseSplit S σ) DerivedCategory.Q)
        (show (1 : ℤ) + n = n + 1 by omega) =
      ShiftedHom.map (Cocycle.equivHomShift.symm
        (Cocycle.fromSingleMk a (zero_add (n + 1)) (n + 1 + 1) rfl ha))
          DerivedCategory.Q
